cards.title: Compiler Pipeline
items: Source code enters through the lexer as a token stream
Parser builds an AST (abstract syntax tree)
Semantic analysis performs type checking and inference
IR lowers the typed AST to an intermediate representation
Bytecode codegen compiles IR to HBC2 bytecode for the VM
LLVM codegen compiles IR to native code via zig cc

cards.title: Execution Modes
items: hc run — bytecode VM (fast development, full language support)
hc run --ir — IR reference interpreter (debug, 100% coverage)
hc build — LLVM native compilation (production, ~75x faster)
hc check — parse + semantic only, no codegen

cards.title: Self-Hosting Bootstrap
items: Stage1 lexer and parser are written in H, not Rust
stage1/parser.hc parses itself — the bootstrap milestone
hc run stage1/parser.hc <file> uses the H parser
hc build stage1/parser.hc produces a native exe (0.32s self-parse)
Rust reference parser preserved as fallback (dual implementation)

cards.title: Tooling
items: hc fmt — token-level formatting with AST fidelity
hc lint — 6 rules (L001–L006): naming, unused vars, simplification
hc doc — generates Markdown API docs from /// comments
hc-lsp — LSP server for IDE integration (Zed, VS Code)
